title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayments predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention pig fattening in their pitches may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who list a wide variety of specific inventory items fund faster.
Female borrowers who specify the number of children they have may fund faster.
Pitches from women that include specific descriptions of their daily routines or the physical environment of their business are associated with slower funding speeds.
Female borrowers who use generic or identical phrasing regarding agricultural inputs may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who specify a longer duration of business operation may fund faster.
Female borrowers who include thank you messages to lenders or organizations may fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who include specific concrete details, such as inventory types or children's ages, may fund faster.
Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'hardworking entrepreneurs' may fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who explicitly name their institutional partner fund faster.
Female borrowers who mention family members or household responsibilities fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention their dreams or aspirations fund faster.
